bugs.description: Write-address decoder drops the MSB: writes to addresses 8-15 alias into 0-7, so a read-after-write to an upper address returns stale data.
Spurious write-first forwarding on the read port breaks the read-first contract: a simultaneous write+read of the same address returns the new data while the scoreboard expects the old data.

description: Memory controller with a 16-entry synchronous-read RAM and a latched-watch-address scoreboard; asserts read-after-write consistency (exercises array reasoning).
